```{r}
mac_2021 <- cfbfastR::cfbd_game_records(
  year = 2021,
  conference = "MAC"
)

View(mac_2021)
```


```{r}
names(mac_2021)
```
```{r}
mac_2021_clean <- mac_2021 |>
  dplyr::select(
    year,
    team,
    total_games,
    total_wins,
    total_losses,
    conference_wins,
    conference_losses,
    postseason_games,
    postseason_wins,
    postseason_losses
  )

View(mac_2021_clean)
```

```{r}
mac_2022 <- cfbfastR::cfbd_game_records(
  year = 2022,
  conference = "MAC"
)

View(mac_2022)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

mac_records_clean <- lapply(2021:2026, function(yr) {
  cfbfastR::cfbd_game_records(
    year = yr,
    conference = "MAC"
  )
}) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  select(
    year,
    team,
    total_games,
    total_wins,
    total_losses,
    conference_wins,
    conference_losses,
    postseason_games,
    postseason_wins,
    postseason_losses
  ) |>
  arrange(year, team)

View(mac_records_clean)
```

```{r}
mac_records_clean <- mac_records_clean |>
  group_by(year) |>
  mutate(
    conference_win_pct = conference_wins /
      (conference_wins + conference_losses)
  ) |>
  arrange(
    year,
    desc(conference_win_pct),
    desc(total_wins),
    team
  ) |>
  mutate(
    conference_rank = row_number()
  ) |>
  ungroup()

View(mac_records_clean)
```
